intro: I help teams turn LLMs into products people rely on: accurate, measurable, and running in production.

services.title: AI assistants on your own documents
services.text: RAG chatbots that answer from your files and policies, show their sources, and are tested for accuracy before launch.

services.title: Agents and text-to-SQL
services.text: Multi-agent workflows and plain-English database chat, so non-technical staff can get answers without writing queries.

services.title: Model fine-tuning
services.text: Adapting open models like Whisper and LLMs to your domain, language or terminology when off-the-shelf models fall short.

services.title: Production AI backends
services.text: FastAPI services with background queues, cloud deployment on AWS or DigitalOcean, and monitoring with Langfuse and Grafana Loki.
services.proof: Deployed on AWS EC2, Lambda and DigitalOcean

process.title: Understand the workflow
process.text: Start with the task people do today, the data it uses and what a good answer looks like.

process.title: Prototype on real data
process.text: A working version in days, not a slide deck, so you can judge it with your own examples.

process.title: Measure before scaling
process.text: Track retrieval accuracy, hallucinations, latency and token cost, and fix what the numbers show.

process.title: Ship and monitor
process.text: Deploy with logging and evaluation in place, then keep improving from real usage.
